newsitem.title: GERMANY: Air Lanka mulls Europe-Asia freighter flights.
newsitem.headline: Air Lanka mulls Europe-Asia freighter flights.

text.p: Air Lanka said it is considering launching an Asia-Europe freighter service in 1998.
The airline's Germany cargo sales executive, Hiran Houx, said Air Lanka was currently discussing whether to go ahead with the plan because of its high global load factors.
"If everything goes well, a Tristar will be converted into a freighter. It is something we are looking into," he told Reuters in an interview.
"It would go between Europe and Asia," he added.
Houx said cargo officials in Colombo would take a decision on the freighter by mid-1997 but he would welcome such a service.

The Sri Lankan air cargo market was growing five percent despite the country's problems, but foreign investors were clearly holding back at present, Houx said. -- Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
